title: Find your trail
review_scope: Editorial comparisons drawn from the five existing illustrated trails and their source notes. No new local arrangements, journey times or suitability ratings verified.

trails.summary: Carved stone, a maker’s painted world and time beside the sea.
trails.travel: Several places, with road transfers. Choose days and breaks before combining them.
trails.season: October–February is a starting point for Puri; check weather for your dates.
trails.arrange: Maker’s welcome, temple entry eligibility and onward transport.

trails.summary: A bird in the reeds, an island story, or a different stretch of open water.
trails.travel: Begin with one gateway. Road transfers and boat outings need separate arrangements.
trails.season: November–February for migratory birds at Mangalajodi; crossings depend on conditions.
trails.arrange: Guide or operator, boarding, lifejackets, weather decision and return.

trails.summary: A fort gateway, a silver thread, a childhood remembered and a favourite bowl.
trails.travel: Stops across the city. Confirm pickups and leave room for meals and rest.
trails.season: Check the forecast and opening days for your dates.
trails.arrange: A museum visit or maker’s appointment to anchor the day.

trails.summary: Watch the shore change, carry a writer’s eye and pause for a coastal meal.
trails.travel: Arrange the town-to-shore trip and return; the reading chapter travels with you.
trails.season: Let current tides, weather and local warnings shape the shore visit.
trails.arrange: Shore access, return pickup and a choice between town and coast for your stay.

trails.summary: Falling water, a story in movement and Mudhi Mansa at a Baripada table.
trails.travel: Give the forest its own time. Arrange the other chapters across suitable days.
trails.season: Follow the reserve’s current opening notice; Chhau needs a confirmed performance date.
trails.arrange: Gate, permit, suitable base and an agreed welcome from performers.
